summary: Boyd Group Services Inc. announced that the Toronto Stock Exchange approved a Normal Course Issuer Bid, effective September 16, 2026 through September 15, 2027, to purchase for cancellation up to 2,779,352 common shares, roughly 10.0% of the public float. As of September 2, 2026, 27,836,435 shares were outstanding and 27,793,526 were in the public float. Daily purchases are capped at 27,837 shares, 25% of average daily volume. Purchases may occur on the TSX, NYSE or alternative platforms at prevailing market prices. The company will use an automatic purchase plan with its broker during blackout periods. Boyd cited undervaluation and capital allocation flexibility while continuing acquisitions. No repurchases occurred in the prior 12 months. Watch execution pace and share-count reduction against capital deployment and leverage.
